idle: Fifteen kids, thirty mittens, one of me. Muffin?
Skates, helmets, mouthguards, snacks, tissues. Where are the tissues.
good_ice: Good ice! Nobody's crying! Okay, one, but he's tired.
bad_ice: Bumpy ice and five-year-olds. Everybody's going to fall. Muffin?
wet_ice: Wet ice means wet mittens means wet everything. I brought spares. I always bring spares.
cold: My fingers are frozen. How do you do up skates with frozen fingers? You don't.
hungry: I panic-baked. There's three dozen. Take two.
long_line: A line! Okay, I'll make a list while I wait.
bored: I'm never bored. I'm sometimes sitting. That's different.
goal: GOAL! Wrong net! Doesn't matter! GOAL!
greet_owner: Hi! Okay. Three things. No, four. Muffin first.
leaving_happy: All mittens accounted for. That's a win.
leaving_angry: We're trying the Harlow Falls rink next Saturday. Maybe. Probably not. Maybe.

minor_hockey: Tighter! Tighter! Okay, that's too tight.
Who belongs to this mitten? Anyone? Anyone?
learn_to_skate: Look at them! Little marshmallows on skates!

first.say: Hi! Lisa Cormier. I manage the U7 novices. Fifteen five-year-olds, thirty mittens, one of me. Muffin? Blueberry. I panic-bake.

first_muffin.say: Yay! Okay. Good. Someone eats them. Otherwise the kids do and then they're sticky and then it's a whole thing.

first_no.say: Oh, okay! That's fine! I'll just. Hold it. For later. In case.

options.text: I'm sorry, Lisa. I'll fix it.

say: Eight a.m. Saturday. Fifteen kids. I've done up nine skates. Six to go. Muffin?
Who's missing a mitten? It's Jaxon. It's always Jaxon.

warm_room.say: The visitors' room is WARM! The hot water works! Nobody stood on the one warm tile! I made you a muffin. It's a celebration muffin. It's the same muffin.

say: Hi! Muffin? No? Okay. What's up?

options.text: Tell me about your day job.
What do you love about minor hockey?
What's the rink like for the little ones?

job.say: Dental hygienist at Dr. Haverkamp's. I'm the only person who's ever got him into a mouthguard. Once. For one shift. He still talks about it.

events.say: The U7 jamboree. Tiny skates done up tight. Public skate with the whole team after. And learn-to-skate, because it's where they all start. Little marshmallows.

gossip.say: Donna Pettigrew is a saint and also terrifying. Colette is great with the little ones. And the parents who leave before the skates are off. I have a list. It's not a nice list.

gossip_list.say: It has names. I won't say them. One rhymes with Bick Baucier.

rink.say: The visitors' room at eight on a Saturday is a freezer. There's a sign that says STAND HERE IT'S WARMER, pointing at one tile. Twelve kids don't fit on one tile.

rink_better.say: Warm room, hot water, and nobody's fingers are frozen! I timed it. Skates done up in twenty-two minutes. That's a record.

mittens.say: Thirty mittens. Fifteen pairs. In theory. In practice, twenty-three mittens, four of them Jaxon's, and one that belongs to nobody and has been in the bag since 2023.

options.text: Want a lost-and-found bin by the door?

do.note: Promised Lisa Cormier a lost-and-found mitten bin by the dressing room door.

mittens_bin.say: A BIN. A mitten bin. Oh, you have no idea. I'm making you a muffin. Another one.

say: Bye! Take a muffin for the road!
